Ability Score Improvement: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Action Surge (on use): Take one additional action on your turn. Once per short or long rest. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.
Action Surge (two uses): Take one additional action on your turn, twice per short or long rest.
Arcane Recovery: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up). None of the slots can be 6th level or higher.
Archdruid: You can use Wild Shape an unlimited number of times. You ignore verbal and somatic components for druid spells, and ignore material components without a cost.
Aura improvements: At 18th level, your aura of Protection and Courage extend to 30 feet.
Aura of Courage: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet cannot be frightened while you are conscious.
Aura of Protection: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.
Bard College: Choose a College of Lore or College of Valor for specialized bard abilities.
Bard College Feature: Your Bard College grants additional features at 3rd, 6th, and 14th level.
Bardic Inspiration (d10): Your Bardic Inspiration die increases to a d10 at 10th level.
Bardic Inspiration (d12): Your Bardic Inspiration die increases to a d12 at 15th level.
Bardic Inspiration (d6): As a bonus action, inspire a creature within 60 feet to add a d6 to one ability check, attack roll, or save within 10 minutes.
Bardic Inspiration (d8): Your Bardic Inspiration die increases to a d8 at 5th level.
Beast Spells: You can cast spells while in Wild Shape form. You can also provide somatic components in beast form.
Blindsense: If you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet of you.
Brutal Critical (1 die): When you score a critical hit with a melee attack, roll one additional weapon damage die.
Brutal Critical (2 dice): When you score a critical hit with a melee attack, roll two additional weapon damage dice.
Brutal Critical (3 dice): When you score a critical hit with a melee attack, roll three additional weapon damage dice.
Channel Divinity (1/rest): Channel divine energy from your deity. Usable once per short or long rest at 2nd level.
Channel Divinity (2/rest): Channel divine energy from your deity. Usable twice per short or long rest at 6th level.
Channel Divinity (3/rest): Channel divine energy from your deity. Usable three times per short or long rest at 18th level.
Cleansing Touch: As an action, end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch. Usable a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once) per long rest.
Countercharm: As an action, begin a performance granting allies within 30 feet advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed. Lasts until the end of your next turn.
Cunning Action: Take a bonus action on each of your turns to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
Danger Sense: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that you can see, such as traps and spells. To gain this benefit, you can't be blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.
Deflect Missiles: When hit by a ranged weapon attack, reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + monk level. If reduced to 0, you can catch the missile and throw it back for 1 ki point.
Destroy Undead (CR 1): Undead of CR 1 or lower that fail their save against Turn Undead are instantly destroyed.
Destroy Undead (CR 1/2): Undead of CR 1/2 or lower that fail their save against Turn Undead are instantly destroyed.
Destroy Undead (CR 2): Undead of CR 2 or lower that fail their save against Turn Undead are instantly destroyed.
Destroy Undead (CR 3): Undead of CR 3 or lower that fail their save against Turn Undead are instantly destroyed.
Destroy Undead (CR 4): Undead of CR 4 or lower that fail their save against Turn Undead are instantly destroyed.
Diamond Soul: You gain proficiency in all saving throws. When you fail a save, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it and take the second result.
Divine Domain Feature: Your Divine Domain grants additional features at 1st, 2nd, 6th, 8th, and 17th level.
Divine Health: The divine magic flowing through you makes you immune to disease.
Divine Intervention: Once per long rest, as an action, call on your deity for aid. Roll percentile dice; on a roll equal to or less than your cleric level, your deity intervenes.
Divine Intervention Improvement: At 20th level, your Divine Intervention automatically succeeds, no roll required.
Divine Sense: As an action, detect celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet. Also detect consecrated or desecrated objects. Usable 1 + Charisma modifier times per long rest.
Divine Smite: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage: 2d8 + 1d8 per spell level above 1st (max 5d8), plus 1d8 against undead or fiends.
Druid Circle Feature: Your Druid Circle grants additional features at 2nd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.
Druidic: You know the secret language of druids. You can speak it and use it to leave hidden messages.
Eldritch Invocations: You learn eldritch invocations that grant new abilities or modify your spells. You learn more as you gain warlock levels.
Eldritch Master: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute entreating your patron to regain all expended pact magic spell slots.
Elusive: No attack roll has advantage against you while you are not incapacitated.
Empty Body: Spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 1 minute with resistance to all damage except force. Spend 8 ki points to cast astral projection on yourself.
Evasion: When subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity save for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.
Expertise: At 1st level, choose two of your skill proficiencies (or one skill and thieves' tools). Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check using either chosen proficiency. At 6th level, you can choose two more of your proficiencies to gain this benefit.
Extra Attack: You can attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action on your turn.
Extra Attack (2): You can attack three times instead of once when you take the Attack action.
Extra Attack (3): You can attack four times instead of once when you take the Attack action.
Fast Movement: Your speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing heavy armor.
Favored Enemy: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track your favored enemies and on Intelligence checks to recall information about them.
Favored Enemy improvement: At 6th and 14th level, you gain additional favored enemies and the bonuses against them improve.
Feral Instinct: You have advantage on initiative rolls. If you are surprised at the start of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.
Feral Senses: You are aware of the location of any invisible creature within 30 feet as long as it is not hidden from you.
Foe Slayer: Once per turn, you can add your Wisdom modifier to an attack roll or damage roll against one of your favored enemies.
Font of Inspiration: You regain all expended Bardic Inspiration dice after a short or long rest.
Font of Magic: You gain sorcery points that can be converted into spell slots and vice versa.
Hide in Plain Sight: Spend 1 minute camouflaging yourself with mud, leaves, and debris. You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks as long as you remain still.
Improved Divine Smite: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon, deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. This is not an expenditure of Divine Smite.
Indomitable (one use): When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it. You must use the new roll. Usable once per long rest.
Indomitable (three uses): When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it. Usable three times per long rest.
Indomitable (two uses): When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it. Usable twice per long rest.
Indomitable Might: If your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.
Jack of All Trades: You can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.
Ki: You gain ki points that fuel your monk abilities. Ki points are regained after a short or long rest.
Ki-Empowered Strikes: Your unarmed strikes count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
Land's Stride: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement. You can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed or taking damage.
Lay on Hands: You have a pool of healing power equal to your paladin level × 5. As an action, you can touch a creature and restore hit points to it. Alternatively, expend 5 hit points from the pool to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. This has no effect on undead and constructs.
Magical Secrets: You can learn spells from any class's spell list. They count as bard spells for you.
Martial Archetype Feature: Your Martial Archetype grants additional features at 3rd, 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.
Martial Arts: Unarmed strikes and monk weapons use Dexterity for attack and damage. Your unarmed strike die is a d4. When you Attack, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action.
Monastic Tradition Feature: Your Monastic Tradition grants features at 3rd, 6th, 11th, and 17th level.
Mystic Arcanum (6th level): You learn one 6th-level spell from the warlock spell list. You can cast it once per long rest without expending a spell slot.
Mystic Arcanum (7th level): You learn one 7th-level spell from the warlock spell list. You can cast it once per long rest without expending a spell slot.
Mystic Arcanum (8th level): You learn one 8th-level spell from the warlock spell list. You can cast it once per long rest without expending a spell slot.
Mystic Arcanum (9th level): You learn one 9th-level spell from the warlock spell list. You can cast it once per long rest without expending a spell slot.
Natural Explorer: Choose a favored terrain type. You have bonuses to navigation, tracking, foraging, stealth, and travel speed in that terrain.
Natural Explorer improvement: You gain more favored terrain types at 6th and 10th level.
Otherworldly Patron Feature: Your Otherworldly Patron grants features at 1st, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.
Pact Magic: You regain all expended pact magic spell slots after a short or long rest.
Path Feature: Your Primal Path grants additional features at 3rd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.
Perfect Self: When you roll initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.
Persistent Rage: Your rage ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.
Primal Champion: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.
Primeval Awareness: As an action, expend one ranger spell slot to sense whether aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead are within 1 mile (or 6 miles in favored terrain).
Purity of Body: You are immune to disease and poison.
Rage: As a bonus action, enter a rage for 1 minute. While raging, you gain advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, bonus damage on melee weapon attacks using Strength, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. You can't cast or concentrate on spells while raging. Ends early if unconscious or if you end it as a bonus action. Usable number of times per long rest based on barbarian level.
Ranger Archetype Feature: Your Ranger Archetype grants features at 3rd, 7th, 11th, and 15th level.
Reckless Attack: When you make your first attack on your turn, you can attack recklessly to gain advantage on Strength melee attacks, but attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.
Relentless Rage: If you drop to 0 hit points while raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5, and resets to 10 after a short or long rest.
Reliable Talent: When you make an ability check that includes your proficiency bonus, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
Ritual Casting: You can cast spells with the ritual tag as a ritual without using a spell slot. The casting time is extended by 10 minutes.
Roguish Archetype Feature: Your Roguish Archetype grants features at 3rd, 9th, 13th, and 17th level.
Sacred Oath Feature: Your Sacred Oath grants features at 3rd, 7th, 15th, and 20th level.
Second Wind: As a bonus action, regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Usable once per short or long rest.
Signature Spells: Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells in your spellbook. They are always prepared and don't count against prepared spells. Cast each once at 3rd level without a spell slot, regaining after a short or long rest.
Slippery Mind: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.
Slow Fall: When you fall, reduce falling damage by 5 × your monk level.
Sneak Attack: Once per turn, you can deal extra 1d6 damage to a creature you hit with an attack using a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage on the attack roll. You don't need advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't incapacitated, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll.
Song of Rest (d10): Your Song of Rest die increases to a d10 at 13th level.
Song of Rest (d12): Your Song of Rest die increases to a d12 at 17th level.
Song of Rest (d6): Allies who spend a Hit Die during a short rest can also add a d6 to the hit points regained.
Song of Rest (d8): Your Song of Rest die increases to a d8 at 9th level.
Sorcerous Origin Feature: Your Sorcerous Origin grants features at 1st, 6th, 14th, and 18th level.
Sorcerous Restoration: When you finish a short rest, you regain 4 expended sorcery points.
Spell Mastery: Choose a 1st-level and a 2nd-level wizard spell in your spellbook. You can cast them at their lowest level without expending a spell slot when you have them prepared. To cast either at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot as normal. By spending 8 hours in study, you can exchange one or both spells for different spells of the same levels.
Spellcasting: You can cast spells using your class's spellcasting ability. Prepare or learn spells from your class's spell list.
Stillness of Mind: As an action, end one effect on yourself causing you to be charmed or frightened.
Stroke of Luck: If you miss with an attack, you can turn the miss into a hit. If you fail an ability check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 20. Usable once per short or long rest.
Stunning Strike: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, spend 1 ki point to stun the target until the end of your next turn. Target makes a Constitution save.
Superior Inspiration: When you roll initiative and have no Bardic Inspiration dice remaining, you regain one.
Thieves' Cant: You know thieves' cant, a secret language of dialect and symbols that lets you hide messages in normal conversation.
Timeless Body: You no longer need food or water, and you cannot be aged magically. You can still die of old age.
Tongue of the Sun and Moon: You understand all spoken languages. Any creature that understands a language can understand what you say.
Tradition Feature: Your Arcane Tradition grants features at 2nd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.
Unarmored Defense: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier (monk) or Constitution modifier (barbarian).
Unarmored Movement: Your speed increases while not wearing armor or wielding a shield. At 9th level, you can run on liquids and up vertical surfaces.
Unarmored Movement improvement: Your Unarmored Movement speed increases by +15 feet at 3rd, +15 at 6th, +15 at 10th, +15 at 14th, and +15 at 18th level.
Uncanny Dodge: When an attacker you can see hits you, you can use your reaction to halve the damage.
Vanish: You can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Your trail cannot be tracked by nonmagical means.
Wild Shape: Transform into a beast you have seen. Usable twice per short or long rest. Duration equals half your druid level in hours.
Wild Shape Improvement: You can Wild Shape into beasts with higher CR limits and your beast form attacks count as magical.
